findings.title: Reached resolver maps remain unadmitted before instance resolution
findings.evidence: The helper admits instances/aliases/callback maps and raw env descriptor, but not Container.contextual/abstractAliases/buildStack or Application.deferredServices. Application.make/resolve calls isDeferredService (isset deferredServices[key]) before the instance check. Container.resolve calls getContextualConcrete before its instance fast path; findInContextualBindings reads contextual[end(buildStack)][abstract], then abstractAliases[abstract] and its aliases. Non-array ArrayAccess maps or nested contextual entries can therefore run offsets after inspect passes; an effective critical contextual resolver can bypass the admitted raw instance.

Keep supported ordinary aliases/env binding positive. Avoid unrelated resolver/frozen-family changes.
